name: v2
basis: v1's form; offsets in bits per sample, fitted on 50 development artists (1,399 rows, artist-grouped 5-fold CV, per-fold offsets 0.55-0.58 and 0.76-0.78). Locked test artists not read. Script: v2.py.
gain: normalization gain + DSP gain filter dB + half the balance attenuation in dB (EQ preamp, tone, pass filters, limiter: not counted)

bits.resample: + resample_c * log2(rate_src / rate_out) when rate_out < rate_src

ratio: clamp(((bits + offset) * ch_src / ch_out + mono_dither) / bps_out, 0.02, 1.01)
offset_padded_bits_when: R1 with bps_out > bps_src (16-bit source zero-padded into 24 bits)

mono_dither_bits.when: R3, one-channel source to two-channel output
mono_dither_bits.basis: 24 constructed one-channel files (rule-testing set, not the fitting set)

padded_guard_bits.when: source deeper than 16 bits, src_bits below this, samples changed (R2/R3/R4): use 0.747
padded_guard_bits.basis: private-library 24-bit minimum 12.35 (31 tracks, 5 artists); constructed 16-in-24 maximum 12.99

known_limits: 20 bits in a 24-bit file above the guard: short by 21-45 %
limiter as the only sample-changing filter: long by 16-44 %
stereo file with identical channels plus gain: long by 44-50 %; with 16-bit output short by 18 %
band-limited old recordings: short by up to 16 %
